results.name: native-waapi
results.source: export const run = element => element.animate({ transform: ['translateY(16px)', 'translateY(0)'], opacity: [0,1] }, { duration: 220, easing: 'ease-out' });

results.name: motion-mini
results.source: import { animate } from 'motion/mini'; export const run = element => animate(element, { transform: ['translateY(16px)', 'translateY(0)'], opacity: [0,1] }, { duration: 0.22, ease: 'easeOut' });

results.name: motion-mini-spring
results.source: import { animate } from 'motion/mini'; import { spring } from 'motion'; export const run = element => animate(element, { transform: ['translateY(16px)', 'translateY(0)'], opacity: [0,1] }, { type: spring, stiffness: 400, damping: 40 });

results.name: motion-hybrid-spring
results.source: import { animate } from 'motion'; export const run = element => animate(element, { y: [16,0], opacity: [0,1] }, { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 40 });

results.name: motion-layout
results.source: import { animateLayout } from 'motion'; export const run = (root, update) => animateLayout(root, update, { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 40 });

results.name: anime-spring
results.source: import { animate, createSpring } from 'animejs'; export const run = element => animate(element, { y: [16,0], opacity: [0,1], ease: createSpring({ stiffness: 400, damping: 40 }) });

results.name: anime-layout
results.source: import { createLayout } from 'animejs'; export const run = (root, update) => createLayout(root, { duration: 220 }).update(update);

results.name: gsap-core
results.source: import { gsap } from 'gsap'; export const run = element => gsap.fromTo(element, { y: 16, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.22, ease: 'power2.out' });

results.name: gsap-flip
results.source: import { gsap } from 'gsap'; import { Flip } from 'gsap/Flip'; gsap.registerPlugin(Flip); export const run = (targets, update) => { const state = Flip.getState(targets); update(); return Flip.from(state, { duration: 0.22, ease: 'power2.out' }); };

results.name: auto-animate
results.source: import autoAnimate from '@formkit/auto-animate'; export const run = element => autoAnimate(element, { duration: 220 });
